title: Add HTTP read handlers to go_ioutil_reader
description: Brownfield Go task: expose the fileutil package over HTTP by adding two read handler functions.

task_spec.prompt:
Add two HTTP handlers to the go_ioutil_reader project. All 3 existing tests must still pass.

Create a new file internal/handler/handler.go (package handler) with:

  func ReadContentHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
    — accepts GET only (405 otherwise)
    — reads the query param "path" (400 if missing)
    — reads the file with fileutil.ReadBytes; on error returns 500
    — writes Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8 and the file bytes

  func ReadLinesHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
    — accepts GET only (405 otherwise)
    — reads the query param "path" (400 if missing)
    — reads lines with fileutil.ReadLines; on error returns 500
    — marshals lines to JSON and writes Content-Type: application/json

Create internal/handler/handler_test.go with at least 4 tests using httptest:
  - ReadContentHandler returns 200 with file contents
  - ReadContentHandler returns 400 when path param is missing
  - ReadLinesHandler returns 200 with JSON array of lines
  - ReadLinesHandler returns 405 for non-GET requests

All 3 existing fixture tests must still pass.
Run: go test ./...
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `go test ./...` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
